quest.title: Kaeya's Gain
quest.description: After much thinking, you finally solve the riddles contained within the intel you were given. The Lost Arcadian Ruins are now within reach!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x60, Mora x3850, Teachings of Ballad x5, Unknown Item #11302 x1, Wanderer's Advice x10, Fine Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Discuss your next step with Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This time, the mysteries have all been solved, it sure took a lot of work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But in all fairness, this treasure map really is terrible... It looks like it was drawn by a pirate...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? Paimon believes that there is no need!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You read my mind! Paimon's so happy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go for it! Don't want anyone else to get there before we do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Like... like the Treasure Hoarders Kaeya told us about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyways, Paimon just wants to borrow the sword to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, you heard nothing! Paimon ah— Paimon just wants to see it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Definitely not to become super, mega, powerful and do nothing but play...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe... Alright, Paimon'll save the chit-chat for later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Arcadian treasure hunt, here we go!

choices.text: Let's go to the treasure location directly!

talks.objective: Use the map to find the buried treasure

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must be the Arcadian Ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just me, or does it look... plain?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! The perfect disguise is always in plain sight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya's grandpa sure is impressive.
*pitter-patter*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Listen, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Mice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You didn't even try, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's no time to get suspicious. We're close!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hurry! The treasure is waiting for us!

talks.objective: Enter the depths of the ruin

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Is this the end?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where are you, my treasure!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's look around, {NICKNAME}.
Hahaha... I'll save you the trouble.
How about you let me take over?

response.text: Sharp eye, but too slow.

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: I'm Izzard.

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: I thank you both on behalf of the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We've been keeping a low profile, how did word get out?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Low... profile...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Paimon won't let you have the treasure without a fight!

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: You would be wise to not underestimate us.

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: My gang is just outside waiting for my order.

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: However, they're not as... sociable as me.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: (Kaeya and the Knights of Favonius enter)

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm sorry to rain on your parade...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: But your gang won't be participating in your current plan.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: If you'd like to ask why, you can go see them... in Mondstadt Prison.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Or perhaps you'd prefer to join them permanently?

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: The Knights...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, it's Kaeya!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kaeya, he wants to steal your treasure! Get him!

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: Ugh... almost had it!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh, you mean the treasure?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Sorry, but there wasn't any treasure to begin with.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You came all the way... for nothing. Just give it up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No... treasure?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did Kaeya just say, there isn't any treasure?

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: Hah. You got me good. Didn't think the Knights would resort to such tactics.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: A thief has no right to criticize the methods of the Knights of Fav— Wait, what are you...

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: You're not gonna get me!

response.speaker: Izzard
response.text: Okay... Oh god... Wh—What is this? I didn't mean it!
Well, I did have dealings with them.
But them and their stupid principles... Losers who can't make a fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Izzard
dialogues.text: How embarrassing... Having my life saved by a knight...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Don't forget what you promised... or that thing will be the least of your worries.

dialogues.speaker: Izzard
dialogues.text: Hey... Is this how the Knights of Favonius treats the people they catch?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I'm just joking. Alright... Let's take him back.

dialogues.speaker: Knight of Favonius
dialogues.text: Sir! Yes sir!

dialogues.speaker: Knight of Favonius
dialogues.text: Captain, should we take these two in as well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, of course not. They are the ones who made this arrest possible.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Without them spreading our <color=#00E1FFFF>fabricated intel</color>, we wouldn't have been able to catch the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *cries* You're a bad man for lying to me... Shame on the Knights!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Alright, alright... Stop it already.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Though the treasure doesn't exist, you did want it for yourself, didn't you?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Otherwise, you would have informed me of your intentions, no?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That... well... ah... Hmph!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Let's go, {NICKNAME}. Paimon's done talking to him!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Ha. Just a sec.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You did help me out, so you do deserve a reward.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: This is the "Triumphant Harbinger of Dawn That Points Towards Victory." As its name suggests, it symbolizes light and victory.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: If you don't mind, I would like to present you with this Harbinger of Dawn as a reward.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Harbinger of Dawn?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That's right. It suits a well-cultured and disciplined person such as yourself, wouldn't you say, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... If the reward is this Harbinger of Dawn...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You'd forgive me, right?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm honored to have such an understanding friend.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes... yes...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You have my apologies for the deception. I will not use the same method twice.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: What a wonderful day. Now, I have to go interrogate my suspect...

choices.text: Means you'll use a different method next time?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Please excuse me. Do come visit me at our headquarters when you have the chance.
